# Erdem Süren

> Full-Stack Software Engineer · .NET & React/Next.js. Back end, front end, mobile, DevOps. Founder of Eribitech. İstanbul, Türkiye.

- BELBİM, Software Development Specialist: built the headless CMS (modular monolith, Clean Architecture), belbim.istanbul and istanbulkart.istanbul (Next.js 15), the servers' Next.js configuration, and version-based content sync in the İstanbulkart mobile back end (RabbitMQ, Redis, Hangfire, FluentValidation). Now building the DevOps system.
- Eribitech, Founder: Eribi, a three-product platform (e-commerce, Eribi Growth, Eribi Creative) on a microservice architecture (9 services behind YARP).
- İGDAŞ, Software Developer: built the Operations Automation System (24/7, field teams) and the Medical Supply Tracking (TMT) app. SAP S/4HANA integration.
- Sets up servers and networks: Windows Server, IIS, Cloudflare, 100+ GitHub Actions workflows.

Turkish at https://erdemsuren.com/, English under https://erdemsuren.com/en/.
